title: Risk Methodology
acceptance_criteria: Trace each displayed risk metric back to real data and formulas; no hard-coded analytical results.

For VaR/CVaR, expose the actual method, confidence level, holding period, and lookback window used. If VaR/CVaR is a placeholder or absent, implement only a transparent historical-return VaR/CVaR with explicit sufficient-data checks, or mark it unavailable with a stated reason.
Verify the maximum drawdown calculation against the underlying price/return series.
Verify largest-position, top-N concentration, effective-holdings, and active-position-concentration metrics against the canonical final portfolio weights.
Distinguish ETF-level return correlation from underlying-holdings overlap; do not conflate the two.
Label stress scenarios explicitly as hypothetical or as historically sourced.
Add methodology metadata/UI and deterministic automated tests covering the above.
prohibited: No ETF application/business-logic changes outside of this task's methodology and disclosure scope.
Do not fabricate risk figures that are not derivable from real portfolio data.
